description: Queue one bounded research calculation; returns a queued run ID. Requires FXMacroData account access; owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

configuration.description: Research settings: base, quote (ISO codes), start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); optional series (up to six {currency, indicator, period_aggregation?}), price_fields, mode, decision_frequency, decision_time_utc (HH:MM), chart_title, chart_type, transform, window_mode, window_months, strategy, suite_options. kind=experiment also needs experiment settings.

kind.description: Study type: chart, backtest, correlation, carry, screener, events or experiment.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key: 16-64 letters, digits or hyphens; reuse only for identical retries.

name: research_run_submit
title: Submit Research Study
